Standard errors are proportional to √RSS (see the RSS note), so they inherit its round-off limit.

The certified RSS is 1.4e-25: the residuals (~1e-13) are at the round-off level of the data (~4e-16 × |y|), so only 2-3 digits of the RSS are representable in double precision. The parameters themselves agree to 10.5 digits.
